svg.title: 3. Small files and table maintenance
svg.text: Before: one S3 object per Lambda invocation
After: buffer at ingest, write Iceberg, compact in the background
Table maintenance (Glue Data Catalog optimizers, or built in with S3 Tables)
The small-files problem: same clickstream, same query, before and after
Every file is a request to list, open and read a footer from.
Planning time grows with file count, not data size.
GETs per prefix hit the 5,500 req/s guidance and get throttled.
~105 M new objects, about $525 in PUT requests alone
1.26 billion objects in the raw zone after a year
Glue crawler runs take hours and add a partition per hour
Need no raw copy? Firehose can
Aim for 128 MB to 1 GB per data file. Partition by what queries filter on (day), not by everything (day + hour + country + device).
Watch average object size in S3 Storage Lens and the Iceberg $files metadata table. Never point a crawler at an Iceberg table.
